data.one_liner: Print via ESC/POS commands on thermal printers using Bluetooth, BLE, USB, or WiFi.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter apps to discover and connect to thermal printers via Bluetooth, BLE, USB, and WiFi. Supports sending raw ESC/POS data as well as rendering widgets directly to print.
use_when: You need to print receipts or labels on thermal printers from mobile or desktop.
You want support for multiple connection types including Bluetooth, USB, and WiFi.
avoid_when: You are printing standard documents (A4/Letter) to general office printers.
strengths: Supports multiple connection types across Android, iOS, macOS, and Windows.
Provides built-in screenshot to printer widget conversion.
Includes image cropping for long prints.
weaknesses: USB printing is not supported on iOS.
Requires platform-specific configuration for permissions and drivers.
data.setup_notes: Ensure Bluetooth permissions and configurations are set correctly for Android and iOS. Make sure you have the XPrinter driver installed on Windows.
